card.name: Words right before the word people
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'people', such as a quantity (million, billion), 'some', 'a lot of', or 'with'. The next word is predicted to be 'people'.

modes.label: Counts of people
modes.description: Number words like million or billion in statistics about how many people are affected.
modes.example: In the United States, 2 to 5<< million>> people have the disorder.

modes.label: Quantifiers and links
modes.description: Words like some, of, with, or most that lead into 'people' or a group of people.
modes.example: There is no way to tell if vitiligo will spread. For<< some>> people, the white patches do not spread

card.writes: It suppresses the word people and its variants, so the model avoids predicting 'people' next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'people' is expected, like '2 million' in a statistic.
